Index.meta_title: Inferon — real cost numbers for every LLM request
Index.meta_description: An OpenAI-compatible gateway that meters, guards and routes your model traffic with true cost visibility and automatic budget protection.

Hero.title: Know the <important>true cost</important> of every LLM request.
Hero.description: Inferon meters, guards and routes your model traffic with real cost numbers and automatic budget protection — through a drop-in OpenAI-compatible API.

Features.section_title: Everything you need to trust your LLM spend
Features.section_description: A metering gateway that stays out of the way — your existing OpenAI client keeps working.
Features.feature1_description: Every request records its tokens and upstream USD cost, rendered as exact decimal strings — never a float.
Features.feature2_description: Per-tenant budgets with an automatic circuit breaker that degrades safely instead of blowing the limit.
Features.feature3_description: Validates and repairs tool-call output, transparently falling back to a frontier model when needed.
Features.feature4_description: Point your client at /v1/chat/completions and keep your existing SDK, keys and request shapes.
Features.feature5_description: Mint and revoke API keys per tenant from the dashboard; only hashes are ever stored.
Features.feature6_description: Humans sign in with GitHub into signed-cookie sessions; teammates join by invite with their own keys.

CTA.title: Ready to see your real spend?
